chapters.title: Geographical Diversity of India
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People

topics.title: Geographical Diversity of India
outcomes: Learner can describe India’s major physical regions and how they shape ways of life
hooks: The Himalayas, Thar, Deccan and coasts in one train journey

chapters.title: Understanding the Weather
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People

topics.title: Understanding the Weather
outcomes: Learner can explain elements of weather (temperature, pressure, wind, humidity, rainfall) and how they are measured
misconceptions: Thinks weather and climate mean the same thing
hooks: Read today’s IMD forecast for your district

chapters.title: Climates of India
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People

topics.title: Climates of India
outcomes: Learner can describe the monsoon and different climatic regions of India and their effect on life
hooks: Why Mawsynram is so wet and Jaisalmer so dry

chapters.title: New Beginnings: Cities and States
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: New Beginnings: Cities and States
outcomes: Learner can describe the emergence of janapadas and mahajanapadas and early cities
hooks: Magadha and the old city of Rajagriha

chapters.title: The Rise of Empires
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: The Rise of Empires
outcomes: Learner can explain how the Mauryan empire rose and how it was governed, including Ashoka’s dhamma
hooks: Ashoka’s edicts and the lion capital on our currency

chapters.title: The Age of Reorganisation
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: The Age of Reorganisation
outcomes: Learner can describe the kingdoms that followed the Mauryas and the growth of trade and culture
hooks: Coins of the Kushanas and Satavahanas

chapters.title: The Gupta Era: An Age of Tireless Creativity
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: The Gupta Era: An Age of Tireless Creativity
outcomes: Learner can describe achievements of the Gupta period in science, mathematics, art and literature
hooks: Aryabhata and the iron pillar at Mehrauli

chapters.title: How the Land Becomes Sacred
chapters.theme: Theme C — Our Cultural Heritage and Knowledge Traditions

topics.title: How the Land Becomes Sacred
outcomes: Learner can explain how rivers, mountains, groves and pilgrimage routes became sacred and connected people across India
hooks: The Char Dham and the Kumbh Mela

chapters.title: From the Rulers to the Ruled: Types of Governments
chapters.theme: Theme D — Governance and Democracy

topics.title: From the Rulers to the Ruled: Types of Governments
outcomes: Learner can compare monarchy, democracy, dictatorship and other forms of government
hooks: Who decides in a family, a class, a country?

chapters.title: The Constitution of India — An Introduction
chapters.theme: Theme D — Governance and Democracy

topics.title: The Constitution of India — An Introduction
outcomes: Learner can explain why a constitution is needed and describe key ideas in the Preamble
hooks: Read the Preamble aloud; 26 November as Constitution Day

chapters.title: From Barter to Money
chapters.theme: Theme E — Economic Life Around Us

topics.title: From Barter to Money
outcomes: Learner can explain the problems of barter and how money evolved, including digital payments
misconceptions: Thinks money has value in itself rather than because people trust it
hooks: UPI payments at the sabziwala

chapters.title: Understanding Markets
chapters.theme: Theme E — Economic Life Around Us

topics.title: Understanding Markets
outcomes: Learner can describe different kinds of markets and how buyers and sellers interact
hooks: Weekly haat vs mall vs online shopping

chapters.title: The Story of Indian Farming
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People

topics.title: The Story of Indian Farming
outcomes: Learner can trace the history of farming in India and describe crops, seasons and challenges faced by farmers today
hooks: Kharif and rabi crops in your state

chapters.title: India and Her Neighbours
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People

topics.title: India and Her Neighbours
outcomes: Learner can locate India’s neighbouring countries and describe shared geography, history and culture
hooks: Rivers that flow across borders: the Brahmaputra and the Indus

chapters.title: Empires and Kingdoms: 6th to 10th Centuries
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: Empires and Kingdoms: 6th to 10th Centuries
outcomes: Learner can describe major kingdoms of this period (such as the Pallavas, Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas and Palas) and their contributions
hooks: Shore temple at Mahabalipuram; Ellora’s Kailasa temple

chapters.title: Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past

topics.title: Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries
outcomes: Learner can describe political changes of the 11th and 12th centuries, including the Cholas and invasions from the north-west
hooks: Chola bronzes and the Brihadeeswara temple

chapters.title: India, a Home to Many
chapters.theme: Theme C — Our Cultural Heritage and Knowledge Traditions

topics.title: India, a Home to Many
outcomes: Learner can explain how many communities and faiths came to live in India and enriched its culture
hooks: Parsi, Jewish and Syrian Christian communities on the west coast

chapters.title: The State, the Government, and You
chapters.theme: Theme D — Governance and Democracy

topics.title: The State, the Government, and You
outcomes: Learner can distinguish the state and the government and describe how government affects daily life
hooks: From birth certificate to driving licence

chapters.title: Infrastructure: Engine of India’s Development
chapters.theme: Theme E — Economic Life Around Us

topics.title: Infrastructure: Engine of India’s Development
outcomes: Learner can explain why roads, railways, power and digital networks matter for development
hooks: How a new highway changes a village

chapters.title: Banks and the Magic of Finance
chapters.theme: Theme E — Economic Life Around Us

topics.title: Banks and the Magic of Finance
outcomes: Learner can describe what banks do, savings and loans, and simple interest in everyday terms
